electrode_spec.name: LNMO electrode, NMP processed (IntelLiGent batch 2, SINTEF)
electrode_spec.description: LiNi0.5Mn1.5O4 (organic solvent processed); high Mn/Ni disorder spinel. Electrode design of the IntelLiGent project batch 2 (SINTEF), published under the label LNMO-NMP-2. Active-material type as stated in metadata.csv: "LNMO".

processing.detail: Organic-solvent electrode coating (NMP), as stated by the public electrode label LNMO-NMP-2 and the Zenodo batch table.

notes: Design values are as published in metadata.csv for batch LNMO-NMP-2, the one batch that realizes this design. The as-built figures of each individual disc are on the 8 electrode records that cite this spec.

Active-mass loading: mean 9.5173 mg/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.3213 mg/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 8.9505-9.99 mg/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.
Dry thickness: 90.0 um for every one of the 8 discs. metadata.csv states this one value per cell, so the standard deviation is 0 by construction - a repeated declaration, not a measured spread.

Nominal areal capacity: mean 1.3324 mAh/cm2, sample standard deviation 0.045 mAh/cm2 over n = 8 discs (range 1.2531-1.3986 mAh/cm2). Computed from the per-cell values metadata.csv publishes for this batch and carried on the quantity itself, not in this note.

Coated from the LNMO study powder lot https://w3id.org/battinfo/material/y7n3-npze-ed51-94jq. The link runs through the material spec: no field on an electrode spec or an electrode record points at a material INSTANCE (gap E8).
